auth.notes: Stripe signs webhooks with a signature header; verification should be done in connector logic

notes: Stripe sends webhook events via POST to your endpoint; verify signature using Stripe-Signature header and webhook secret
The customer email is available in customer_details.email when customer is not pre-existing
Metadata fields like plan_id are passed through from session creation
For subscription mode, the session will have a subscription ID after completion; consider expanding subscription to get plan details if metadata is insufficient
Requires list_id and subscriber_hash (MD5 of lowercase email) in path
Audience and tag must exist beforehand; tag will be created if it does not exist when using this endpoint
Use status: active to add tag, status: inactive to remove
No pagination; this is a singular operation per member
